Description

These giants roam the frost lands raiding nearby villages and hunting down beasts.

Defense

AC 21, touch 8, flat-footed 21 (+4 armor, -1 Dex, +9 natural, -1 size)

hp 133 [182] (14d8+70)

Fort +14, Ref +3, Will +6

Defensive Abilities Rock Catching

Immune Ice

Resist Earth 15, wind 50%

Weakness Fire

Offense

Speed 40 ft.

Melee Greataxe +19/+14 (3d6+13) or 2 Slams +18 (1d8+9)

Ranged Rock +9 (1d8+13)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Earthquake, Ice Roar, Rock Throwing (120 ft.)

Statistics

Str 29, Dex 9, Con 21, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 11

Base Atk +10; CMB +20; CMD 29

Feats Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Overrun, Improved Sunder, Martial Weapon Proficiency (greataxe), Power Attack, Weapon Focus (greataxe)

Skills Climb +13, Intimidate +16, Perception +13

Languages Common, Giant

Combat Gear chain shirt, greataxe

description.value: Special attack listed in the source statblock: Rock Throwing (120 ft.).
Once per round with a readied action: Reflex DC 15/20/25 to catch a Small/Medium/Large rock; add its enhancement bonus.

Once every 1d2 rounds, an ice gigas can cause the ground to erupt around it within a 30-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of earth damage and are inflicted with the Weighted status effect for 1d6 rounds. A successful Reflex save (DC 22) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 23).

effect: Half damage, no Weighted. On failure Weighted [[1d6]] rounds.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 23).

description.value: 3/day, an ice gigas roars an icy cone blast within 30-ft. burst. Any creature within the area of effect takes 10d6 points of ice damage and are inflicted with the Frozen status effect. A successful Reflex save (DC 22) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 25).

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 25).

description.unidentified: This two-handed battle axe is heavy enough that you can't wield it with one hand. The head may have one blade or two, and may be "bearded" (meaning hooked or trailing at the bottom) to increase cleaving power and help pull down enemy shields. The haft is usually 3 to 4 feet long.
